That makes the decision notable both clinically and commercially for a rare disease population. The approval marks a regulatory milestone for BridgeBio and for LGMD treatment.

The article emphasizes shared workflows, clear handoffs, and clinical measures between virtual and in-person settings. That focus suggests operational integration matters as much as technology deployment. The story highlights practical steps for making telebehavioral care sustainable.

A health system technology leader and an IT consultant describe financial, operational, and clinical burdens from redundant applications. The piece also explains why consolidating tools is difficult in practice. It frames EHR sprawl as a governance and workflow problem, not just a budgeting issue.

articles.title: Why ambient AI notes need more than a sign-off

Dr. Niki Panich says doctors need to verify high-risk details before approval. She also calls for health systems to audit notes against visit recordings. The piece focuses on safety, oversight, and governance for clinical documentation AI.
